title: 爬
teacherNotes: Production B complete-package handoff for L300 爬. Use approved sentences exactly. L300 is the last normal lesson before the next required review lesson set. Latest origin/main must be verified before release. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate. Keep climbing scenes safe, low, and preschool-appropriate: no dangerous heights, no horror, no severe injury, no labels or visible writing.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L297 + provisionalLearnedChars ["罵","對"] + current new char 爬
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, subtitles, or readable marks.
Climbing and startling scenes must be preschool-safe: no dangerous heights, no severe injury, no horror, no attack, no bullying.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 爬 as public/assets/lessons/L300/audio/char-u722c.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩正想爬一棵低矮的樹，主角媽媽站在旁邊嚴肅提醒她不要爬樹。畫面要清楚呈現不要爬樹、會被罵的情境；樹要低矮安全，不可有文字、數字、標籤，不要畫成危險高樹。
主角小女孩爬到遊樂場低矮攀爬架或低矮平台上，覺得太高而嚇到哭，主角爸爸在旁邊伸手保護。畫面要清楚呈現爬太高、嚇到哭；不可有危險高處、文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩爬上家中的桌子，主角媽媽在旁邊提醒這樣不對。畫面要清楚呈現爬上桌子是不對的行為；桌子高度安全，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小男孩在室內或生日派對場景旁邊，附近一顆氣球破掉，他被突如其來的聲音嚇到。畫面要清楚呈現氣球破掉、嚇到小孩子；不可有文字、數字、標籤，不要畫成驚悚或過度害怕。
主角小女孩誤以為主角哥哥弄壞玩具而罵了他，後來發現罵錯人，表情很抱歉，主角哥哥站在旁邊。畫面要清楚呈現罵錯人後覺得對不起；不可出現文字、數字、對話框或標籤。

coverageCheck.allowedCharacterAudit: Expected PASS; Production must verify against latest production JSON learned chars plus provisionalLearnedChars and current new char.
